## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Drive Google's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Drive Google data without official API access
- Automate actions on drive.google.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Drive Google frontend uses

```typescript
import { DriveGoogleClient } from "./scripts/api.ts";

```
